correctness.rationale: For the metric multigraph with r>=3 unit parallel edges plus a pendant h, centered resistance Green representation gives Q(x)=F(x)/(r+h)-J/[2(r+h)^2]. On each parallel edge F=F0+(h/r)t+k t(1-t) with k=r-2+(r-1)h/r>0, and its unique maximum occurs at x=(r-2+h)/(2k). On the pendant F=F0+z²+(r-h)z is convex and its tip exceeds the junction by rh. Direct integration of profiles gives J=[r²+(r+2)h+3rh²+h³]/3. The difference of two candidate maxima has exactly one positive zero; solving 4rhk=(r-2+h)^2 gives the displayed h_r, 0<h_r<1 and limit 1/4. Scalar multiples of centered representers are the complete equality functions. My independent sympy checks at r=3,4,11 verified the radical identity and candidate-value equality; the broad resistance envelope independently yields the same curvature k.
